justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/decoder/BarcodeMetadata.java and its main consumer core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/decoder/DetectionResultRowIndicatorColumn.java. BarcodeMetadata is a small immutable value object: 1 constructor, 5 getters, 5 final fields, and only 37 lines of actual class body; it only stores PDF417 metadata (column count, row counts, error-correction level) and exposes accessors. The surrounding code uses it as a simple data carrier, not as a class with multiple separable responsibilities, so there is no evidence of insufficient modularization.
